# Stepan Turchenko

> AI Integration Specialist and Senior Fullstack engineer / Tech Lead.

Stepan Turchenko brings AI into real business processes (Claude Code, AI agents, workflow automation) and owns the engineering that ships and runs production software end to end: mobile, backend, infrastructure, and the team around it. More than six years of production work across the US, UK and Russia.

## What he does
- Bring AI into the business: map where AI agents and automation save time, then build and integrate them into existing processes and tools.
- Build and ship the product end to end: mobile and backend, payments, analytics, release, and the team.
- Lead the engineering: set standards, run interviews and reviews, keep heavy systems stable under load.

## Selected work
- Painta (https://painta.io): an AI art coach built as a full product - mobile app, backend, admin, payments, and automations.
- Aspect Health (https://www.aspect-health.com): a Delaware women-health and wellness platform with an AI agentic app, run as a heavy production service.
- Nana800 (http://nana800.io): his own low-code automation platform with visual scenarios, integrations, and AI blocks.
- Moscow Sport (https://sport.mos.ru/): the Moscow government sport app, rescued and shipped after a state contractor failed.

## Stack
AI & Automation: Claude Code, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, N8N, Cursor.
Frontend & Mobile: React, React Native, TypeScript, Zustand, Expo.
Backend & Data: Node.js, Nest.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, RabbitMQ, Microservices.
DevOps & Cloud: Docker, CI/CD, Google Cloud, AWS, Grafana, Loki, Nginx, Traefik.
W3-certified in TypeScript and React.
